headline: TTCL jumps 33.3% while TRITN and KC tumble 33.3% each, marking the day’s most volatile swings.
market_take: Property stocks led the market with double‑digit losers TRITN and KC (-33.33% each) and a sharp -20% gap for PF, but EVER managed a +16.67% gain. Food showed mixed activity: MADAME rose 10.84% after its CB trading sign was lifted, while XBIO and TWPC posted sizable intraday declines and volume spikes. Several unusual‑trading alerts clustered in Food and Property, and earnings filings were released for CONS, PF&REIT and CONMAT, with TPOLY under a new trading sign.

sector_notes.note: MADAME rose 10.84% after a CB trading sign was lifted; XBIO fell 12.5% with an intraday drop and a 2.11× volume spike; TWPC posted a 14.6σ volume spike and a 7.14% intraday decline; AQUA opened with a 9.09% gap down.

TRITN and KC each dropped 33.33% on open price gaps and very low volume; PF opened down 20% on a gap; JCK surged 8.33% on an open gap and a 10.7σ volume spike; AMATAV jumped 7.77% on an open gap; EVER gained 16.67% modestly.
PLE jumped 14.29% intraday; SOLAR fell 8.33% intraday; TRC reported revised Q2 earnings and disclosed a related‑party financial assistance transaction.
QHOP experienced a -100% price gap; GVREIT released multiple Q3 earnings filings.
PPPM and NER showed volume spikes of 3.3σ and 4.8σ respectively.
